contact.title_zh: 機器人控制與 Physical AI 工程師

summary.en: AI Robotics Engineer with an M.S. in Electrical Engineering, focused on ROS 2, Isaac Sim / Isaac Lab, MoveIt 2, robot learning, visual perception, and physical-robot validation. Experienced in connecting perception, policy inference, and Dockerized robotics software into practical workflows.
summary.zh: AI 機器人工程師，具電機工程碩士背景，專注於 ROS 2、Isaac Sim／Isaac Lab、MoveIt 2、Robot Learning、視覺感知與實體機器人驗證。具備將感知、Policy Inference 與 Docker 化機器人軟體整合至實際流程的經驗。

experience.company_zh: 瑞軒科技股份有限公司

en: Built ROS 2 control and simulation workflows for industrial and collaborative robot platforms with Isaac Sim / Isaac Lab, MoveIt 2, and cuMotion.
Delivered Isaac GR00T N1.7 data conversion, model training, and policy inference across simulation and physical-robot workflows.
Built a ROS 2 / WebSocket training-data collection flow that automated robot-arm tasks and recording for AI and robotics data workflows.
Integrated visual perception, robot control, and physical-robot validation with YOLO OBB, OpenCV, AprilTag, and Dockerized robotics software.
zh: 以 ROS 2 串接工業／協作型機械手臂平台、Isaac Sim／Isaac Lab、MoveIt 2 與 cuMotion，完成機器人控制與虛實驗證。
完成 Isaac GR00T N1.7 資料轉換、模型訓練與 Policy Inference，涵蓋虛擬與真實機器人流程。
建立透過 ROS 2／WebSocket 協作的訓練資料蒐集流程，支援 AI 與機器人資料流程。
整合視覺感知、機器人控制與真機驗證，使用 YOLO OBB、OpenCV、AprilTag 與 Docker 化軟體流程。

experience.company_zh: 采威國際資訊股份有限公司（ISCOM）

en: Participated in backend API development, frontend integration, and web feature implementation using C#, ASP.NET MVC, JavaScript, jQuery, MS SQL, and Git.
zh: 參與後端 API 開發、前端串接與網頁功能實作，使用 C#、ASP.NET MVC、JavaScript、jQuery、MS SQL 與 Git。
